Collecting Elemental Pickups or destroying <strand/>Tangles grants 1 Stack of Armor Charge upon reaching 100% Activation Progress.

Activation Progress with 1|2|3 Mods equipped:
• <solar/>Firesprites, <void/>Void Breaches, <strand/>Tangles: 50%|50%|100%
• <arc/>Ionic Traces: 34%|50%|50%
• <stasis/>Stasis Shards: 25%|34%|50%
